review_note: Reviewed 2026-10-24 from all eight native CASCI(19,14) product-side probes at 2, 3.5, 6 and 30 angstrom in both bases. Select CAS(5,4), 2 angstrom source indices 19-22: CH2S pi/pi-star (19/22; occupations approximately 1.896/0.110 near and 1.893/0.113 far) contribute two electrons, and the SH pi frontier pair (20/21; approximately 1.500 each) contributes three. The two SH orbitals exchange order/rotate at separation, so retain their span rather than reselecting an ordinal. C-S and S-H sigma pairs remain inactive; their near-degenerate occupied/virtual members mix at short range (17/18 and 23/24), while their far occupations stay about 1.97/0.03. This compact exit-channel choice has no matched compact correlated-potential convergence test; the distinct homolysis-channel CAS(7,6) comparison is not transferred as validation. The [5,4] separation connects CH2S atoms [1,3,5,6] and SH atoms [2,4], not H2. Two equally weighted doublets support the orbitals; only D1 contributes reactive flux. Use separate basis-specific seeds and direct CASPT2-F12 aDZ/aTZ CBS, power 3.7. Existing production scan guards retain review of S-H/CH2S connectivity, root character and long-range convergence. The outer RotdPy dividing surfaces use fragment centers of mass; their distances are COM separations. The one-dimensional relaxed/frozen correction remains the mapped interfragment anchor scan from the saved product complex. Both grids retain the explicit production distance lists; they are distinct coordinates and must not be interchanged.
